note: Author URLs, not invented mirrors. No upstream checksums were published here; observed SHA256 is recorded locally. Download availability and full real-data layouts remain unverified in this package.

additional_preparation.isic: Reorganize public training images into author class directories 1/2/3 using the DR-Adapter mapping linked in docs/data.md; downloader does not execute remote preprocessing code.
additional_preparation.fss: Download from https://github.com/HKUSTCV/FSS-1000 and place class folders in FSS-1000/data, split lists in FSS-1000/splits. CG-ICS datasets/splits/fss provides the audited lists; pass --split-file explicitly if kept there.
additional_preparation.pascal: Prepare VOC2012/JPEGImages and SegmentationClassAug as described in https://github.com/ANDYZAQ/GF-SAM/blob/master/datasets/README.md ; pass CG-ICS datasets/splits/pascal/val/foldN.txt with --split-file. No unverified download URL is automated.
additional_preparation.isaid: Preserve source-image grouping. P#### prefixes are recognized; otherwise provide --group-map. Indexed semantic masks only, not raw RGB instance masks.
